reading.title: The Word Part Un
reading.purpose: Learn how the little word part un changes a word.
paras: The word part un can mean not. Unkind means not kind. Unfair means not fair.
Un can also mean to do the opposite. You unlock a door with a key. You untie a shoe. You unfold a paper. You can even undo a mistake.

qs.why: The reading says un can mean not, so unkind means not kind.

qs.q: What do you do with a key?
qs.why: The reading says you unlock a door with a key.

qs.q: What does it mean to undo a mistake?
choices: Take it back and fix it.
qs.why: Un can mean the opposite, so undo means take back what you did.
